case_name: Yaduraj Singh and Others v State of Uttar Pradesh
respondent:
State of Uttar Pradesh
Supreme Court of India

5 August 1975
Cr.A. No. 193 of 1975.
The Judgment was delivered by : CHANDRACHUD, J.
1.   Eight persons were convicted by the learned Sessions Judge, Kanpur, u/s. 307 read with S. 149 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860. They were sentenced to suffer rigorous imprisonment for a period of five years each. There was also a charge against those persons under Section 302, but except for Shatrughan Singh, they were acquitted of that charge. The order of acquittal u/s. 302 was not challenged by the State in appeal, but those who were convicted u/s. 307 read with S. 149 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 
 filed an appeal in the High Court of Allahabad. In so far as the four appellants are concerned, the High Court altered their conviction and found them guilty u/s. 325 read with S. 149 and reduced their sentences from five years to three years.
